definitions.explanation: An organized body, especially a chamber of commerce, or the building where such assemblies meet.

examples.japanese: {商工会議所|しょうこうかいぎしょ}に{相談|そうだん}した。
examples.english: I consulted the chamber of commerce and industry.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{会議所|かいぎしょ}で{説明会|せつめいかい}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: An information session was held at the local chamber.

examples.japanese: {商工会議所|しょうこうかいぎしょ}は{中小企業|ちゅうしょうきぎょう}の{支援|しえん}や{地域経済|ちいきけいざい}の{活性化|かっせいか}に{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: The chamber of commerce works on supporting small and medium businesses and revitalizing the regional economy.

notes:
Most commonly encountered in the compound {商工会議所|しょうこうかいぎしょ} (chamber of commerce and industry), which is an organization that supports local businesses. Every major city in Japan has one. They offer services such as business consulting, certification exams (including the popular {簿記|ぼき} bookkeeping exam), and networking events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {商工会議所|しょうこうかいぎしょ}: chamber of commerce and industry
- {国際商業会議所|こくさいしょうぎょうかいぎしょ}: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC)
- {会議所|かいぎしょ}の{会員|かいいん}: chamber member

RELATED TERMS:
- {商工会|しょうこうかい}: commerce and industry association (for smaller municipalities)
- {会議|かいぎ}: meeting; conference
- {会議室|かいぎしつ}: meeting room
